title: Large gaps between successful backups
description: Consider only successful backups. For each database_name derive previous_finished_seq with LAG ordered by finished_seq ASC, backup_id ASC and gap_seq = finished_seq - previous_finished_seq. Return only rows where gap_seq is at least 10. Return exactly five columns: backup_id, database_name, finished_seq, previous_finished_seq, gap_seq. Final sort: gap_seq DESC, database_name ASC, backup_id ASC.
starter_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  SELECT backup_id, database_name, finished_seq
  FROM backups
)
SELECT
hints: A window function cannot be filtered in the WHERE of the same SELECT; use a CTE or subquery.
Failed backups must not affect previous_finished_seq.
solution_explanation: The window first builds the successful-backup sequence, then the outer query filters the derived gap.
